entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer Planeswalker who trained at Keral Keep, becomes abbot after Serenok's death, and turns down Gideon and Jace's request to help on Zendikar.

entities.name: Serenok
entities.description: The aging abbot of Keral Keep who trains Chandra and dies in his sleep.

entities.name: Mother Luti
entities.description: The matriarch of Keral Keep who offers Chandra the abbot's mantle.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A famous pyromancer and Planeswalker who inspired the founding of Keral Keep and whom Chandra is compared to.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Planeswalker who comes to ask Chandra for help against the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage Planeswalker who accompanies Gideon and speaks into Chandra's mind.

entities.name: The hellion
entities.description: A giant lava-swimming monster that attacks the monks in the lava field.

entities.name: Keral Keep
entities.description: The fire monks' monastery on Regatha where Chandra trained.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Chandra's adopted home plane with volcanoes and lava fields.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane the Eldrazi are devouring, for which Gideon and Jace need Chandra's help.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: Where Gideon tells Chandra to find them if she changes her mind.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The monsters Gideon says he is after.

entities.name: The fire monks of Keral Keep
entities.description: The pyromancer monks of Keral Keep who chant and dance to make fire.

entities.name: Mount Keralia
entities.description: The mountain by Keral Keep where Chandra speaks with Gideon and Jace.

events.summary: Chandra and the fire monks chant and dance in a lava field, but Serenok scolds her for not joining the spell properly.
participants: The fire monks of Keral Keep
events.quote: "The spell will fail if you don't participate."

events.summary: A hellion bursts from the lava field and attacks the monks.
participants: The fire monks of Keral Keep
events.quote: Something gigantic burst forth from the lava bed.

events.summary: Chandra climbs the hellion, tricks it into biting its own armor, and has the monks unleash their fire at her, weaving it into a spike that drives the hellion off.
participants: The fire monks of Keral Keep
events.quote: she wove the strands of fire together into a needle-sharp streak of blindingly hot fire.

events.summary: Serenok tells Chandra she is ready and that she is Jaya.
Mother Luti wakes Chandra to tell her Serenok is dead.
Serenok's memorial is held outside Keral Keep and Chandra, grieving, walks into the mountains.
participants: The fire monks of Keral Keep
events.quote: She walked away from the Keep, deeper into the mountains.

events.summary: Luti presents Serenok's mantle and reveals the monks have chosen Chandra as the new abbot.
events.quote: "I'm here to tell you we've already chosen one."

events.summary: Chandra initially refuses to be abbot, then wavers when Luti repeats Serenok's phrase about the perfect challenge.
events.quote: Then, as Serenok was fond of saying, this will be the perfect challenge for you,

events.summary: Gideon and Jace burst into the chamber as Chandra considers accepting the mantle.
events.quote: "It's good to see you, Chandra," said Gideon Jura. "We need your help."

events.summary: Gideon and Jace ask Chandra to join them against the Eldrazi, and Jace reminds her of her responsibility for Zendikar's state.
events.quote: You have a hand in Zendikar's current state.

events.summary: Chandra tells them to go, saying she belongs on Regatha and has made a promise.
events.quote: "I belong here. I've made a promise."

events.summary: Gideon and Jace planeswalk away, and Chandra walks up the steps toward Mother Luti and the mantle.
events.quote: Chandra nodded to Mother Luti, and walked up the steps toward her.

relations.quote: Serenok had pushed Chandra's talents in fire magic

relations.note: Matriarch of the monastery who pushed her talents.
relations.quote: Like Mother Luti, the matriarch of the monastery

relations.note: The abbot, head teacher of the Keep.
relations.quote: As the abbot, the head teacher of Keral Keep

relations.target: The fire monks of Keral Keep
relations.note: Trained among them and invited to become their abbot.
relations.quote: This place, these people who had taught her so much, wanted her to teach them.
she sprung onto its side, grabbed hold of its body spines, and clambered onto its back.

relations.note: They met recently on Ravnica and travel together.

relations.quote: miles from the Keral Keep monastery on Regatha
